dog.description_text: Meet Blueberry, the tiniest of her litter with the sweetest eyes! This 2-month-old Shepherd/Terrier mix was rescued with her two sisters after they were dropped off at our partner shelter in Kentucky. Now this little girl has a whole new life ahead of her! Blueberry is a sweet, loving puppy who can learn to live with kids, other dogs, and cats with gentle introductions and guidance. She’s ready to grow alongside a family who can give her the time, training, and love every puppy needs. Blueberry has been vetted and has started her puppy vaccine series. As the runt, she needs to gain a little more weight before her spay, which will be coordinated by Rescue City. Apply to adopt Blueberry at rescuecity.nyc/adopt.
dog.name: Blueberry
